name: Andrew Chou
office: City of Diamond Bar, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Andrew Chou is a member of the Diamond Bar City Council representing District 3. He was elected in 2018 and served as mayor in 2023. He founded a financial planning advisory firm in Diamond Bar. On the council, he serves on the Economic Development and Legislative subcommittees and represents the city on regional boards, including the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments and the San Gabriel Valley Regional Housing Trust.
